mentions.name: ArkWatch
mentions.description: A monitoring API usable with a single curl command, no signup required. It watches a given URL and emails the user when the page content changes, with a free tier of 10 checks per day.
mentions.problem: Existing monitoring tools force users through signup flows, credit cards, and complex dashboards, when solo founders just need basic 'alert me when this changes' monitoring.
mentions.audience: Solo founders and side-project developers who need simple change monitoring without signup flows
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on ArkWatch (https://watch.arkforge.fr) - a monitoring API that you can use with just curl, no signup required.
